title: How the drummer sets tempo in dance and brass bands
summary: He explains how tempo is set in dance bands and how bass drum cadences bring in brass bands and funerals.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
